title: lifeos.ecomae.com Cloudflare 502 — origin :5100 down

probe.lifeos: HTTP/2 502 from Cloudflare (cf-ray present, body error code: 502)
probe.www: also failing / connect issues — shared ecomae-platform :5100

diagnosis: Cloudflare 502 on lifeos.ecomae.com / www.ecomae.com. Agent re-probe after user action still 502. Meanwhile https://www.epartscart.com/lifeos returns 200 (warmup splash) — so shared :5100 may already be up and the ecomae hostnames' Cloudflare origin/nginx vhost is the failure plane.
fix: Re-run recover script (republish + lifeos nginx confirm + origin diagnostics). If local :5100 PASS but public FAIL, point Cloudflare A records for lifeos.ecomae.com and www.ecomae.com at the same origin IP as epartscart.
